name: Domain / group policy issue
description: Checks domain membership and recent group policy errors.

rules.cause: This workstation reports that it is not domain joined.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Confirm whether domain membership is expected. Escalate membership changes through your normal approved workflow.

rules.cause: Group Policy logged errors in the last 24 hours; they may explain policy issues.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Review Microsoft-Windows-GroupPolicy/Operational events and DNS/connectivity. Run the approved policy refresh action only after investigating the error.
